summary: Tested team standings and stats functionality. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend displays standings correctly with Eagles (1W-0L, GF:5, GA:2, Pts:2) and Hawks (0W-1L, GF:2, GA:5, Pts:0) in Premier Division.

minor.issue: division_id field not included in formatted team response - teams have division_id in DB but it's not returned in dashboard-data

action_items: Consider adding division_id to dashboard-data team response for consistency (currently only 'division' name is returned)
critical_code_review_comments: Stats aggregation in _update_team_season_stats correctly includes goals_for, goals_against, goal_diff, pf, pa fields
Dashboard-data endpoint correctly returns team stats (wins, losses, goals_for, goals_against, points)
Player stats (goals, assists, gamesPlayed) are included in dashboard-data player response
League standings API correctly filters by division_id and sorts by points
Admin recalculate-stats and update team endpoints work correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team standings and stats are working correctly. Eagles shows 1W-0L (5-2) and Hawks shows 0W-1L (2-5) in Premier Division. The stats were manually set in the teams collection. The game_stats collection has games but only one with status='final' and it has None scores. Future games should properly update game_stats with status='final' and correct scores for automatic stats calculation.
